profile.headline: Embedded SWE

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed low-level inverter software in C specifically for driver integration, CAN signal monitoring support in C, and CAN API support.

Additionally, served as interim software technical program manager for Inverter team working with internal and external software and hardware teams. In this role, I coordinated features with many different cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Field Applications Engineering Image Sensor Intern
positions.description: Frequently communicated with customers through meetings and recreated customer software problems to give solutions, developed Python script to automate auto exposure routine for image sensors, and extensively referenced and read image sensor documentation to aid in customer support.

positions.title: Embedded System Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Aided Mission Systems embedded software team in developing test binary message files for system testing, debugged program launching in real-time using Green Hills AdaMulti Software, and updated hardware configuration GUI with latest hardware updates using .xml file edits.

positions.title: Computer Science Elementary and Junior High Teacher
positions.description: Taught basic elements of Python to elementary and junior high students about basic elements, some of which included variables, loops, logical and mathematical operators, and defining functions and created PowerPoint presentations, in-class exercise worksheets, Kahoot quizzes, and a Jeopardy game to keep students engaged.

honors.title: International Member
honors.issuer: Issued by Phi Theta Kappa Honor Society · Feb 2018
